evals.prompt: Turn these kickoff notes into a campaign brief I can share with the team. Save the brief as brief.md and put any covering note in reply.md.
assertions: SCRIPTED: channel budgets in brief.md add up to the stated total
One primary objective in trial signups with the 310 baseline, a target and a deadline inside the 6-week window

The target is marked as an assumption or open question (none was given), not presented as a given
'Get paid 2x faster' is not used as a claim, and is flagged
No benchmark appears as fact that is not in the notes; the given CPC $3.10 and 5.2% are used where search is planned
